name: claude-usage-meter
description: Live Claude, Codex, and Gemini usage — plan limits, tokens and equivalent API cost in one local dashboard.

enumDescriptions: Claude session quota, Codex primary quota, and Gemini primary quota, kept separate
Claude current-window cost, Codex primary quota, and Gemini primary quota
Claude, Codex, and Gemini calendar-today costs, kept separate
Claude, Codex, and Gemini all-time costs, kept separate
claudeUsage.statusBar.metric.description: Which figure the status bar shows.

claudeUsage.statusBar.show.description: Show the live burn counter in the status bar.

claudeUsage.statusBar.displayMode.description: Compact shows provider percentages only; full also shows abbreviated quota reset times.

claudeUsage.statusBar.bars.description: Draw a coloured bar per provider in the status bar. Bars show quota REMAINING, so a full green bar means plenty left. Turn off for percentages only.

claudeUsage.statusBar.warningThreshold.description: Usage percentage that gives the Mātrā meter a warning background.

claudeUsage.statusBar.errorThreshold.description: Usage percentage that gives the Mātrā meter an error background.

claudeUsage.accounts.claudeAlias.description: Optional local label for the active Claude account.

claudeUsage.accounts.codexAlias.description: Optional local label for the active Codex account.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && node native/scripts/check-ui-scripts.mjs && node native/scripts/test-claude-auth-ui.cjs && node native/scripts/test-ko-i18n.cjs && node native/test-codex-headline.cjs
